column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 04 (M23004): masuk Mokosh, Vasily menyerahkan komando.
# Tetap Inggris: Mokosh, Vasily, Wulfgar, Zhaohui, Klukai, Cheyanne, Mayling, George,
# Oathguards, Mangi Security, The Elmo, Doll, Frame, Neural cloud, ELID, P.M.C.,
# Yellow Zone, Financial Conglomerate.

(In order to avoid being detected by the enemy's radar, I had Mayling keep The Elmo's engine silent, hiding in a remote location about a dozen kilometers away from Mokosh, and together with the previously arranged entourage, took a lighter and more concealed jeep to Mokosh.)
column2: (Agar tidak tertangkap radar musuh, kuminta Mayling mematikan suara mesin Elmo dan bersembunyi di lokasi terpencil sekitar belasan kilometer dari Mokosh, lalu bersama rombongan yang sudah diatur sebelumnya, kami menuju Mokosh dengan jip yang lebih ringan dan tidak mencolok.)

column1: (Fortunately, Mangi Security's encirclement was not yet complete. The interior of Mokosh remained intact, with only a few spots in the outer building complexes beyond the dome occupied by Mangi Security.)
column2: (Untungnya, kepungan Mangi Security belum rampung. Bagian dalam Mokosh masih utuh, hanya beberapa titik di kompleks bangunan luar di balik kubah yang sudah diduduki Mangi Security.)

column1: (We abandoned all conventional routes. Under Cheyanne's reconnaissance, we exploited the gaps in the enemy's incomplete encirclement. Utilizing the maintenance routes in the water facilities provided by Vasily, we eventually slipped through the enemy's blockade without incident and successfully infiltrated Mokosh.)
column2: (Kami meninggalkan semua rute konvensional. Berbekal pengintaian Cheyanne, kami memanfaatkan celah kepungan musuh yang belum rapat. Lewat jalur perawatan fasilitas air yang diberikan Vasily, akhirnya kami lolos dari blokade musuh tanpa insiden dan berhasil menyusup ke Mokosh.)

column1: ...It's quite different here from the last time we visited.
column2: ...Di sini beda sekali dibanding terakhir kali kita datang.

column1: Mhm... The area has completely entered a state of combat readiness.
column2: Mhm... Kawasan ini sudah sepenuhnya masuk status siaga tempur.

column1: (Following Klukai's gaze, the once bustling main road had now been forcibly cut off by an intersecting array of metal chevaux de frise, sandbags, and anti-vehicle fortifications.)
column2: (Mengikuti arah pandang Klukai, jalan utama yang dulu ramai kini terputus paksa oleh jajaran duri besi bersilang, karung pasir, dan benteng anti-kendaraan.)

column1: (The doors and windows of the shops facing the street were tightly closed. Almost around every other building, supplies for combat and materials for building temporary fortifications were deployed.)
column2: (Pintu dan jendela toko-toko di tepi jalan tertutup rapat. Hampir di setiap dua bangunan, tertata perbekalan tempur dan material untuk membangun benteng sementara.)

column1: (At the end of the line of sight, a large number of Mokosh residents were carrying heavy luggage, silently and orderly evacuating to the underground defense facilities under the guidance of the Oathguards.)
column2: (Di ujung pandangan, banyak warga Mokosh memanggul barang berat, mengungsi dengan tenang dan tertib ke fasilitas pertahanan bawah tanah di bawah arahan Oathguards.)

column1: (There was no hysterical crying or chaotic pushing. People's luggage was not only stuffed with their only daily necessities, but also stacked with various ammunition and first aid supplies provided to the front line.)
column2: (Tidak ada tangis histeris atau dorong-dorongan kacau. Bawaan mereka tak hanya berisi kebutuhan sehari-hari yang tersisa, tapi juga bertumpuk amunisi dan perbekalan P3K untuk garis depan.)

column1: Enough living supplies have been prepared in the defense facilities! Everyone in District 3, please enter as soon as possible!
column2: Perbekalan hidup di fasilitas pertahanan sudah cukup! Warga Distrik 3, segera masuk!

column1: The supplies everyone donated to the Oathguards can just be left at the door, thank you everyone!
column2: Sumbangan untuk Oathguards cukup ditaruh di depan pintu, terima kasih semuanya!

column1: Don't worry, with Vasily and us here, we will definitely protect you!
column2: Tenang saja, selama ada Vasily dan kami, kalian pasti kami lindungi!

column1: Dad, why do we have to go underground?
column2: Ayah, kenapa kita harus ke bawah tanah?

column1: Hmm... because it's very dangerous outside right now. We have to hide well underground.
column2: Hmm... karena di luar sekarang sangat berbahaya. Kita harus bersembunyi baik-baik di bawah tanah.

column1: Dangerous? Is it ELID?
column2: Berbahaya? Apa itu ELID?

column1: Will the big brothers of the Oathguards protect us?
column2: Apa kakak-kakak Oathguards akan melindungi kita?

column1: ...Mhm, they will protect us. Dad will also protect you and Mom.
column2: ...Mhm, mereka akan melindungi kita. Ayah juga akan melindungi kamu dan Ibu.

column1: Darling... is it really okay?
column2: Sayang... apa ini benar-benar tidak apa-apa?

column1: Rest assured, Mokosh's defense facilities are very robust.
column2: Tenang saja, fasilitas pertahanan Mokosh sangat kokoh.

column1: Once you enter the defense facility, I'll go sign up to help the Oathguards protect the city.
column2: Begitu kalian masuk fasilitas pertahanan, aku akan mendaftar membantu Oathguards menjaga kota.

column1: But this is war, I...
column2: Tapi ini perang, aku...

column1: Darling, we grew up in this city just like Vasily... and Vasily gave us a chance to dream in the Yellow Zone.
column2: Sayang, kita tumbuh besar di kota ini sama seperti Vasily... dan Vasily memberi kita kesempatan untuk bermimpi di Yellow Zone.

column1: In such a huge Yellow Zone... there are very few places where we can survive. Since there's no way back, we'll live and die with this place.
column2: Di Yellow Zone yang seluas ini... hanya sedikit tempat yang bisa membuat kita bertahan hidup. Karena tidak ada jalan kembali, kita hidup dan mati bersama tempat ini.

column1: Not to mention what's in your belly... I absolutely will not hand over the future of our children to the conglomerate!
column2: Belum lagi yang ada di perutmu... aku sama sekali tidak akan menyerahkan masa depan anak-anak kita pada konglomerat!

column1: ...Since you know clearly that I'm carrying your child, you must come back to me, you must!
column2: ...Kalau kau memang tahu aku sedang mengandung anakmu, kau harus kembali padaku, harus!

column1: Protect this place; leave the matters at home to me.
column2: Jaga tempat ini; urusan rumah serahkan padaku.

column1: ...The people here, hmph, are even stronger than I imagined.
column2: ...Orang-orang di sini, hmph, ternyata lebih kuat dari bayanganku.

column1: Humans don't have many choices in the Yellow Zone. Even if they leave now, they have nowhere to go.
column2: Manusia tidak punya banyak pilihan di Yellow Zone. Kalaupun pergi sekarang, mereka tidak punya tujuan.

column1: Because of this, their morale and determination to defend this place are very strong.
column2: Justru karena itu, semangat dan tekad mereka mempertahankan tempat ini sangat kuat.

column1: I feel like the Oathguards are also very hyped up...
column2: Rasanya Oathguards juga lagi semangat-semangatnya...

column1: I heard the enemy has sent a considerable force. I really don't know if Mokosh can hold out this time.
column2: Katanya musuh mengerahkan pasukan yang cukup besar. Aku benar-benar tidak tahu apa Mokosh bisa bertahan kali ini.

column1: Boss, we can definitely hold it! Didn't we train so hard before just for now?
column2: Bos, kita pasti bisa bertahan! Bukankah kita latihan mati-matian selama ini justru untuk sekarang?

column1: This is my first actual combat, I'm still waiting to earn merit for our squad!
column2: Ini pertempuran nyata pertamaku, aku masih menunggu kesempatan menyumbang jasa untuk regu kita!

column1: What merit, you kid sure dream beautifully...
column2: Jasa apanya, mimpimu indah sekali, Nak...

column1: If all the brothers in our squad can survive this time... I... I'll treat everyone to a drink.
column2: Kalau semua saudara di regu kita selamat kali ini... a-aku traktir semuanya minum.

column1: Really? I didn't expect you, Squad Leader, who is usually so stingy, to be quite generous at the critical moment! Hehe!
column2: Serius? Tak kusangka Ketua Regu yang biasanya pelit ternyata royal juga di saat genting! Hehe!

column1: I heard Mr. Vasily is already overseeing the construction of defensive fortifications, and Captain Wulfgar has also taught everyone how to use the new equipment.
column2: Katanya Pak Vasily sudah mengawasi pembangunan benteng pertahanan, dan Kapten Wulfgar juga sudah mengajari semua orang memakai perlengkapan baru.

column1: Plus, we've trained for so many months! Don't worry too much, we'll definitely win!
column2: Lagi pula kita sudah latihan berbulan-bulan! Jangan terlalu cemas, kita pasti menang!

column1: Sigh... Youngsters, war is not such an easy thing. Especially the enemy's chariots and large armor... Ah, never mind, just pretend I didn't say anything.
column2: Hah... Anak muda, perang itu tidak segampang itu. Apalagi kereta perang dan lapis baja besar musuh... Ah, sudahlah, anggap saja aku tidak bilang apa-apa.

column1: Young man, keep your confidence and optimistic spirit. That might be an important factor in us winning this war.
column2: Anak muda, jaga rasa percaya diri dan semangat optimismu. Itu mungkin faktor penting kita memenangkan perang ini.

column1: Don't worry, Squad Leader, our brothers are all good men, we definitely won't embarrass you, Squad Leader!
column2: Tenang, Ketua Regu, saudara-saudara kita semuanya orang baik, kami pasti tidak akan mempermalukanmu!

column1: Alright, stop talking nonsense. Hurry up and go check your equipment.
column2: Sudah, jangan omong kosong lagi. Cepat periksa perlengkapanmu.

column1: (The older Oathguard punched the young man. When the two threw themselves into training again, their expressions were completely different.)
column2: (Oathguard yang lebih tua meninju pemuda itu. Saat keduanya kembali tenggelam dalam latihan, ekspresi mereka sama sekali berbeda.)

column1: (Watching this scene, I couldn't bring myself to criticize the veteran's worries, because he knew the cruelty of war better than anyone; and the young man's blind optimism, at this very moment, was also an indispensable spark to support morale.)
column2: (Menyaksikan itu, aku tidak tega mengkritik kecemasan si veteran, sebab dia lebih paham kekejaman perang daripada siapa pun; dan optimisme buta si pemuda, tepat saat ini, juga percikan yang tak tergantikan untuk menopang semangat.)

column1: (The threat of war was like an invisible boulder pressing on everyone's shoulders, but the trust in this city and the hope for the future also became an important spiritual support for everyone before this war.)
column2: (Ancaman perang seperti batu besar tak kasatmata yang menindih bahu semua orang, tapi kepercayaan pada kota ini dan harapan akan masa depan juga menjadi penopang batin yang penting bagi mereka menjelang perang.)

column1: (...I hope Vasily can shoulder this heavy burden.)
column2: (...Semoga Vasily sanggup memikul beban seberat ini.)

column1: (Watching the soldiers training seriously, I quickened my pace and called Vasily's number.)
column2: (Sambil menonton para prajurit berlatih serius, kupercepat langkahku dan kuhubungi nomor Vasily.)

column1: (Beep beep beep, beep beep beep—)
column2: (Tut tut tut, tut tut tut—)

column1: (But only a busy tone came from the communication channel.)
column2: (Tapi dari kanal komunikasi hanya terdengar nada sibuk.)

column1: (I turned to call the command center's number, but still no one answered.)
column2: (Kuganti dengan nomor pusat komando, tapi tetap tidak ada yang menjawab.)

column1: (What's going on?)
column2: (Ada apa ini?)

column1: (The unease in my heart is gradually intensifying.)
column2: (Kegelisahan di hatiku makin menjadi.)

column1: (Right then, a familiar figure appeared in sight—)
column2: (Tepat saat itu, sosok yang kukenal muncul di pandangan—)

column1: (I quickly called out to the Oathguard captain in the distance, who was also walking hurriedly with a group of soldiers following behind him.)
column2: (Cepat kupanggil kapten Oathguard di kejauhan itu, yang juga sedang berjalan tergesa dengan serombongan prajurit di belakangnya.)

column1: Commander? Why are you here?
column2: Komandan? Kenapa Anda ada di sini?

column1: The plan was temporarily moved up. What, Vasily didn't notify you? Did something happen? I can't contact him.
column2: Rencananya mendadak dimajukan. Apa, Vasily tidak memberitahumu? Ada yang terjadi? Aku tidak bisa menghubunginya.

column1: (Wulfgar leaned close to me and lowered his voice.)
column2: (Wulfgar mendekat dan merendahkan suaranya.)

column1: Half an hour ago, someone infiltrated the command center to assassinate Vasily.
column2: Setengah jam lalu, ada yang menyusup ke pusat komando untuk membunuh Vasily.

column1: Assassination...!
column2: Pembunuhan...!

column1: How is Vasily now?
column2: Bagaimana keadaan Vasily sekarang?

column1: Rest assured, his life is not in danger for now.
column2: Tenang, nyawanya untuk sekarang tidak dalam bahaya.

column1: Fortunately, your Doll happened to be there and blocked the fatal blow.
column2: Untungnya Doll Anda kebetulan ada di sana dan menahan serangan mematikan itu.

column1: But to prevent the news from leaking, we temporarily cut off all external communication lines.
column2: Tapi untuk mencegah kabarnya bocor, kami memutus sementara semua jalur komunikasi keluar.

column1: (Hearing Wulfgar's explanation, I breathed a slight sigh of relief.)
column2: (Mendengar penjelasan Wulfgar, aku sedikit lega.)

column1: (Although I could guess that with the Financial Conglomerate's methods, they would definitely secretly plant special personnel in Mokosh... I didn't expect their actions to be so fast and their strikes so ruthless.)
column2: (Meski aku bisa menduga bahwa dengan cara main Financial Conglomerate, mereka pasti menanam orang khusus diam-diam di Mokosh... aku tidak menyangka gerakan mereka secepat dan sekejam ini.)

column1: (Moreover, under the protection of the Oathguards, Mokosh's defenses were at least considered tight, yet they were still able to directly pose a threat to the city's supreme leader...)
column2: (Lebih dari itu, di bawah perlindungan Oathguards, pertahanan Mokosh setidaknya tergolong rapat, tapi mereka tetap bisa langsung mengancam pemimpin tertinggi kota ini...)

column1: (Presumably, in order to seize the strategic stronghold of Mokosh, the conglomerate and Mangi Security will definitely become even more unscrupulous moving forward.)
column2: (Bisa dipastikan, demi merebut benteng strategis Mokosh, konglomerat dan Mangi Security akan makin tidak tahu batas ke depannya.)

column1: (Under Wulfgar's guidance, we quickly arrived at the command center. At this time, the heads of all departments in Mokosh were gathered here, discussing something around a hospital bed. And on that hospital bed was Vasily, looking somewhat pale.)
column2: (Dipandu Wulfgar, kami cepat tiba di pusat komando. Saat itu, para kepala seluruh departemen Mokosh berkumpul di sana, berdiskusi mengelilingi sebuah ranjang rumah sakit. Dan di ranjang itu terbaring Vasily, wajahnya agak pucat.)

column1: (His shoulder was wrapped in bandages, but his spirits seemed good. He was holding a tablet and saying something to Zhaohui beside him.)
column2: (Bahunya dibalut perban, tapi semangatnya tampak bagus. Dia memegang tablet sambil mengatakan sesuatu pada Zhaohui di sebelahnya.)

column1: (I strode over. Seeing me, Vasily showed a face full of joy. If he wasn't being held down on the hospital bed by the nurse, he would probably have stood up immediately and given me a strong hug.)
column2: (Kulangkahkan kaki cepat ke sana. Melihatku, wajah Vasily langsung berbinar. Kalau tidak ditahan perawat di ranjang, dia mungkin sudah langsung berdiri dan memelukku erat.)

column1: Commander, you're here!
column2: Komandan, Anda datang!

column1: How are your injuries?
column2: Bagaimana lukamu?

column1: Thanks to Captain Zhaohui discovering the assassin in time, it's just a bullet graze, nothing compared to previous injuries.
column2: Berkat Kapten Zhaohui yang menemukan pembunuhnya tepat waktu, ini cuma serempetan peluru, bukan apa-apa dibanding luka-luka sebelumnya.

column1: Let's not talk about me, Commander, quickly look at this!
column2: Sudahlah soal saya, Komandan, cepat lihat ini!

column1: (Vasily raised the tablet and showed me the image on the screen:)
column2: (Vasily mengangkat tabletnya dan menunjukkan gambar di layar:)

column1: (It was a spacious and bright computer room. Several large servers were placed in the center of the room. By the wall at the back of the room, dozens of brand new Doll Frames could be vaguely seen, as well as corresponding maintenance rooms.)
column2: (Sebuah ruang komputer yang luas dan terang. Beberapa server besar terpasang di tengah ruangan. Di dinding belakang, samar-samar terlihat puluhan Frame Doll yang masih baru, berikut ruang perawatannya.)

column1: How is it? Are you satisfied with this underground Doll combat base you asked me to build?
column2: Bagaimana? Puas dengan markas tempur Doll bawah tanah yang Anda minta saya bangun ini?

column1: The Neural cloud transmission and backup functions have already been inspected by Miss Mayling before. The stored backup Frames should also be enough to last for a while.
column2: Fungsi transmisi dan cadangan Neural cloud sudah diperiksa Nona Mayling sebelumnya. Frame cadangan yang tersimpan juga seharusnya cukup untuk sementara waktu.

column1: That's great, now we don't have to worry about Doll maintenance issues during combat anymore. Thank you, Vasily.
column2: Bagus sekali, sekarang kita tidak perlu khawatir soal perawatan Doll selama pertempuran. Terima kasih, Vasily.

column1: Hah, no need to be polite, Commander. As an engineer, this is all I can do for this great battle.
column2: Hah, tidak perlu sungkan, Komandan. Sebagai insinyur, cuma ini yang bisa saya lakukan untuk pertempuran besar ini.

column1: The person Mokosh should truly thank is you.
column2: Yang benar-benar patut disyukuri Mokosh adalah Anda.

column1: (Signaling the nurse to leave, Vasily put away his smile and his expression became serious.)
column2: (Setelah memberi isyarat pada perawat untuk keluar, Vasily menghapus senyumnya dan ekspresinya berubah serius.)

column1: Commander, I just read the battle situation briefing you sent.
column2: Komandan, saya baru saja membaca laporan situasi tempur yang Anda kirim.

column1: Although I've been preparing for this battle all along, when it really comes to facing it, my heart still pounds.
column2: Meski selama ini saya terus bersiap untuk pertempuran ini, saat benar-benar menghadapinya, jantung saya tetap berdebar.

column1: Facing a real battle is indeed not an easy thing.
column2: Menghadapi pertempuran sungguhan memang bukan hal mudah.

column1: However, this is exactly what I came for.
column2: Tapi justru untuk itulah aku datang.

column1: In my opinion, if Mokosh resists alone, this battle will indeed be very difficult. But if The Elmo's combat power is added, supplemented by reliable tactics, it's not impossible for Mokosh to win.
column2: Menurutku, kalau Mokosh melawan sendirian, pertempuran ini memang akan sangat berat. Tapi kalau ditambah daya tempur Elmo dan didukung taktik yang solid, bukan mustahil Mokosh menang.

column1: Really? Commander, does Mokosh have a hope of winning?
column2: Sungguh? Komandan, Mokosh punya harapan menang?

column1: Our peripheral sentries have absolutely no means to fight back when encountering the opponent's Doll forces and armored forces...
column2: Pos jaga terluar kami sama sekali tak berdaya saat berhadapan dengan pasukan Doll dan lapis baja lawan...

column1: The opponent's equipment is much more sophisticated than ours, it can even be said... there is an insurmountable technological generational gap between our equipment and theirs.
column2: Perlengkapan lawan jauh lebih canggih dari kami, bahkan bisa dibilang... ada jurang generasi teknologi yang tak terjembatani antara perlengkapan kami dan mereka.

column1: That's right. The enemy's equipment is indeed mostly far superior to ours, but the Dolls under my command have more sophisticated weapons... although it indeed cannot make up for the numerical gap with the opponent.
column2: Betul. Perlengkapan musuh memang sebagian besar jauh lebih unggul, tapi para Doll di bawah komandoku punya senjata yang lebih canggih... walau memang tidak bisa menutup selisih jumlah dengan lawan.

column1: But, for Mokosh to win this battle, we don't need to repel all the enemy's forces.
column2: Tapi, agar Mokosh menang di pertempuran ini, kita tidak perlu memukul mundur seluruh pasukan musuh.

column1: In fact, we only need to cause unbearable attrition to the enemy.
column2: Sebenarnya kita hanya perlu membuat musuh menanggung kerugian yang tak sanggup mereka tahan.

column1: The conglomerate has two main starting points for attacking Mokosh: one is profit—to take back the production lines that originally belonged to the conglomerate; the second is a demonstration, using Mokosh as an example to kill the chicken to scare the monkeys, eliminating the possibility of other territories rebelling again.
column2: Konglomerat menyerang Mokosh dengan dua motif utama: pertama keuntungan—merebut kembali lini produksi yang dulu milik mereka; kedua unjuk kekuatan, menjadikan Mokosh contoh agar wilayah lain takut dan tidak lagi berani memberontak.

column1: By the way, Vasily was assassinated today, have you found out the killer's background?
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, Vasily diserang pembunuh hari ini, sudah ketahuan latar belakang pelakunya?

column1: Yes, it was someone sent by the conglomerate.
column2: Sudah, orang kiriman konglomerat.

column1: Same as my estimate. Vasily, under your efforts, Mokosh already has a cohesion far beyond imagination.
column2: Sesuai perkiraanku. Vasily, berkat usahamu, Mokosh sudah punya kekompakan yang jauh melampaui bayangan.

column1: Even as I just arrived, I can feel the high morale here. The enemies who have been in a brief stalemate with you must surely feel the same.
column2: Bahkan aku yang baru datang bisa merasakan tingginya semangat di sini. Musuh yang sempat bersitegang denganmu pasti merasakan hal yang sama.

column1: Therefore, assassination is a quick way to dismantle Mokosh. At the same time, this means there is an expectation within the conglomerate to minimize losses: if the assassination succeeds, the conglomerate can retake Mokosh at a minimal cost.
column2: Karena itu, pembunuhan adalah cara cepat meruntuhkan Mokosh. Sekaligus ini menandakan ada harapan di internal konglomerat untuk menekan kerugian: kalau pembunuhan itu berhasil, mereka bisa merebut Mokosh dengan biaya minimal.

column1: Otherwise, the conglomerate will have to invest a large amount of troops and enter a war of attrition with Mokosh. And it will be... a life-and-death war of attrition.
column2: Kalau tidak, konglomerat harus menanam banyak pasukan dan masuk ke perang gesekan dengan Mokosh. Dan itu akan jadi... perang gesekan hidup-mati.

column1: ...For the Financial Conglomerate, if they prolong the front line at Mokosh, the losses will far outweigh the gains.
column2: ...Bagi Financial Conglomerate, kalau garis depan di Mokosh berlarut-larut, kerugiannya jauh melebihi keuntungan.

column1: Exactly. So, we must drag the Financial Conglomerate into this war of attrition as much as possible... or at least make them think they've been dragged into a hopeless war of attrition.
column2: Tepat. Jadi, kita harus semaksimal mungkin menyeret Financial Conglomerate ke perang gesekan ini... atau setidaknya membuat mereka merasa sudah terseret ke perang gesekan tanpa harapan.

column1: This is indeed easier than winning as imagined. Just like when a building's load exceeds the maximum weight its load-bearing beams can support, once the "military expenditure" beam collapses, the Financial Conglomerate is highly likely to retreat!
column2: Ini memang lebih mudah daripada menang seperti yang dibayangkan. Seperti bangunan yang bebannya melampaui daya tahan balok penopangnya, begitu balok "biaya perang" itu patah, Financial Conglomerate sangat mungkin mundur!

column1: Yes. Based on the current combat power estimate, if all the Doll squads The Elmo can support are deployed, combined with Mokosh's long-standing close-in defense projects, we can completely handle Mangi Security's forces.
column2: Ya. Berdasarkan perkiraan daya tempur saat ini, kalau semua regu Doll yang bisa didukung Elmo dikerahkan, dipadu proyek pertahanan jarak dekat Mokosh yang sudah lama disiapkan, kita sanggup menangani pasukan Mangi Security.

column1: Coupled with the assistance of the Oathguards and Mokosh's geographical advantage, it shouldn't be difficult to hold the line.
column2: Ditambah bantuan Oathguards dan keunggulan medan Mokosh, menahan garis pertahanan seharusnya tidak sulit.

column1: Combat matters are actually simple for Dolls. You've been preparing the material reserves and fortifications, so I'm not worried either.
column2: Urusan tempur sebenarnya sederhana bagi para Doll. Cadangan material dan benteng sudah kausiapkan, jadi aku juga tidak khawatir.

column1: The most tricky part left is the safety of Mokosh's residents—in defensive operations, damage to the city is unavoidable, and the citizens must be transferred to safe shelters as early as possible.
column2: Yang paling rumit tinggal keselamatan warga Mokosh—dalam operasi bertahan, kerusakan kota tidak terhindarkan, dan warga harus dipindahkan ke tempat aman sedini mungkin.

column1: You don't need to tell us, Commander. We've already started.
column2: Tidak perlu Anda ingatkan, Komandan. Kami sudah memulainya.

column1: The outer cities on the surface were already arranging evacuations when we lost contact with the sentinel station, and most of the residents were already living underground to begin with.
column2: Kota-kota luar di permukaan sudah mengatur evakuasi sejak kami kehilangan kontak dengan pos jaga, dan sebagian besar warga memang sudah tinggal di bawah tanah sejak awal.

column1: A while ago, we converted the previously idle underground waterways into a shelter, and we've been arranging for civilians to evacuate there sequentially. There are 3 sectors left, and we expect to finish today.
column2: Beberapa waktu lalu, kami mengubah saluran air bawah tanah yang menganggur jadi tempat perlindungan, dan terus mengatur pengungsian warga secara bergiliran. Tersisa 3 sektor, dan diperkirakan selesai hari ini.

column1: Good, just as expected of you! This way we won't have to worry about our rear.
column2: Bagus, memang beda kalau kau! Dengan begini kita tidak perlu cemas soal barisan belakang.

column1: Commander, shouldn't I be saying that to you? With your help, Mokosh truly has nothing to worry about now.
column2: Komandan, bukankah saya yang seharusnya mengatakan itu pada Anda? Dengan bantuan Anda, Mokosh benar-benar tidak punya kekhawatiran lagi.

column1: (As we were talking, Wulfgar approached and gave Vasily a wink.)
column2: (Saat kami bicara, Wulfgar mendekat dan memberi kedipan mata pada Vasily.)

column1: (As if receiving some signal, Vasily's expression suddenly became serious.)
column2: (Seolah menerima suatu isyarat, ekspresi Vasily mendadak serius.)

column1: Commander, as you know, although I serve as the nominal leader of Mokosh, I have always been just an engineer. I have no talent for commanding combat, nor any real experience in dealing with the battlefield.
column2: Komandan, seperti yang Anda tahu, meski secara nama saya pemimpin Mokosh, saya selalu hanya seorang insinyur. Saya tidak punya bakat memimpin pertempuran, tidak pula pengalaman nyata menghadapi medan perang.

column1: At first, when I led everyone against George, we failed repeatedly. It was only after you came to Mokosh and guided us that Mokosh learned how to truly fight and reclaimed its freedom from the consortium.
column2: Dulu, saat saya memimpin semua orang melawan George, kami gagal berkali-kali. Baru setelah Anda datang ke Mokosh dan membimbing kami, Mokosh belajar cara bertempur yang sebenarnya dan merebut kembali kebebasannya dari konsorsium.

column1: So, in the name of the leader of Mokosh, I have a presumptuous request—
column2: Karena itu, atas nama pemimpin Mokosh, saya punya satu permintaan yang lancang—

column1: (Vasily looked at me and took a deep breath.)
column2: (Vasily menatapku dan menarik napas dalam.)

column1: Commander, I want to hand over the highest command of the Mokosh Defense Forces to you.
column2: Komandan, saya ingin menyerahkan komando tertinggi Pasukan Pertahanan Mokosh kepada Anda.

column1: Please do not decline, Commander. This is the unanimous opinion of Wulfgar and me.
column2: Tolong jangan menolak, Komandan. Ini pendapat bulat saya dan Wulfgar.

column1: Yes, although I am the captain of the Oathguards and have indeed served in the army, in terms of combat command experience, I lose too much compared to you, Commander.
column2: Benar, meski saya kapten Oathguards dan memang pernah berdinas di ketentaraan, soal pengalaman memimpin pertempuran, saya kalah jauh dari Anda, Komandan.

column1: Not just me, if it were any Oathguard with combat experience, or any Mokosh resident with a brain standing here, they would choose the same.
column2: Bukan cuma saya, kalau Oathguard mana pun yang berpengalaman tempur, atau warga Mokosh mana pun yang berakal sehat berdiri di sini, mereka akan memilih hal yang sama.

column1: Commander, your talents and combat record, Wulfgar and I have heard about from the Dolls under your command, and we have also witnessed them with our own eyes in previous battles.
column2: Komandan, bakat dan rekam jejak tempur Anda sudah kami dengar dari para Doll di bawah komando Anda, dan kami saksikan sendiri di pertempuran-pertempuran sebelumnya.

column1: Please believe me, Commander, entrusting the highest wartime command to you is the most responsible choice for Mokosh.
column2: Percayalah, Komandan, menyerahkan komando tertinggi masa perang kepada Anda adalah pilihan paling bertanggung jawab bagi Mokosh.

column1: (Vasily held my hand.)
column2: (Vasily menggenggam tanganku.)

column1: The people of Mokosh long to have their own tomorrow. To protect this "tomorrow", Mokosh will do its utmost.
column2: Warga Mokosh mendambakan hari esok milik mereka sendiri. Demi melindungi "hari esok" itu, Mokosh akan berusaha sekuat tenaga.

column1: We built bases, prepared weapons, stockpiled supplies, and drilled the army.
column2: Kami membangun markas, menyiapkan senjata, menimbun perbekalan, dan melatih pasukan.

column1: But, Commander, you and I both know this isn't enough.
column2: Tapi, Komandan, Anda dan saya sama-sama tahu ini belum cukup.

column1: So, please, assist us in your capacity as the highest military commander.
column2: Maka, tolong bantu kami dalam kapasitas sebagai panglima militer tertinggi.

column1: To protect the future of Mokosh—
column2: Demi melindungi masa depan Mokosh—

column1: Since you put it that way, I really can't decline anymore.
column2: Kalau kau bilang begitu, aku benar-benar tidak bisa menolak lagi.

column1: (I squeeze Vasily's hand in return.)
column2: (Kubalas genggaman tangan Vasily.)

column1: I promise you, Vasily.
column2: Aku berjanji padamu, Vasily.

column1: As Mokosh's closest ally, and the appointed commander.
column2: Sebagai sekutu terdekat Mokosh, sekaligus panglima yang ditunjuk.

column1: I will work with everyone to fully protect Mokosh's future.
column2: Aku akan bekerja bersama semua orang untuk melindungi masa depan Mokosh sepenuhnya.

column1: Without further ado, Commander, let's start the official pre-battle meeting as soon as possible. There are still many things that need to be—
column2: Tanpa berpanjang lebar, Komandan, mari segera mulai rapat resmi prapertempuran. Masih banyak hal yang perlu—

column1: (Beep—beep—)
column2: (Bip—bip—)

column1: (Before Vasily finished speaking, a piercing alarm suddenly sounded.)
column2: (Sebelum Vasily selesai bicara, sirene melengking mendadak berbunyi.)

column1: (Mokosh's air defense early warning radar network constantly sounded alarms. Missiles and artillery directly attacked Mokosh's dome without any prior notice.)
column2: (Jaringan radar peringatan dini pertahanan udara Mokosh terus meraung. Rudal dan artileri langsung menghantam kubah Mokosh tanpa peringatan apa pun.)

column1: (The fire control system immediately locked onto the flight trajectory of the missiles and launched interceptor missiles, shattering the missiles in the air.)
column2: (Sistem kendali tembak langsung mengunci lintasan rudal dan meluncurkan rudal pencegat, menghancurkannya di udara.)

column1: (But as the enemy's firepower coverage became increasingly powerful, the interception system soon reached the limit of its defense, and Mokosh's dome defense force field was also activated immediately.)
column2: (Tapi seiring makin dahsyatnya cakupan tembakan musuh, sistem pencegat segera mencapai batas pertahanannya, dan medan gaya pertahanan kubah Mokosh pun langsung diaktifkan.)

column1: (Vasily brought up the battlefield surveillance. It wasn't just Mokosh's dome under attack. A dense array of drones hovered in the sky at the entrance of Mokosh, seemingly wanting to form an oppressive momentum with interwoven firelight.)
column2: (Vasily membuka pemantauan medan tempur. Bukan hanya kubah Mokosh yang diserang. Kawanan drone yang rapat melayang di langit gerbang Mokosh, seolah hendak membangun tekanan lewat jalinan kilatan tembakan.)

column1: It seems the Financial Conglomerate is even more urgent than us.
column2: Sepertinya Financial Conglomerate lebih terburu-buru daripada kita.

column1: Then, let them feel Mokosh's determination too.
column2: Kalau begitu, biar mereka juga merasakan tekad Mokosh.

column1: All squads, prepare for battle!
column2: Seluruh regu, bersiap tempur!

column1: (As the distance closes, the suffocating smell of machine oil and gunpowder smoke gradually fills the air. Through the tactical binoculars, the full tragic picture of Mokosh's perimeter ruthlessly crashes into view. Mangi Security is absolutely not engaging in a simple display of forceful deterrence; they are weaving an airtight net of slaughter with heavy troops.)
column2: (Seiring jarak menyempit, bau oli mesin dan asap mesiu yang menyesakkan perlahan memenuhi udara. Lewat teropong taktis, gambaran tragis lengkap di perimeter Mokosh menghantam pandangan tanpa ampun. Mangi Security sama sekali bukan sedang unjuk gertak; mereka sedang menganyam jaring pembantaian yang rapat dengan pasukan berat.)

column1: (Outside Mokosh, Mangi Security's signature gray-blue coating looks like an iron curtain swallowing the horizon, stretching all the way to the edge of the field of vision.)
column2: (Di luar Mokosh, warna kelabu-biru khas Mangi Security bagai tirai besi yang menelan cakrawala, membentang sampai ujung pandangan.)

column1: (Organized heavy chariots and fully armed mobile mechs stand shoulder to shoulder, building a suffocating Wall of Sighs. The firepower of this equipment has already far exceeded P.M.C. specifications, and some are even practically identical to those used by the regular army.)
column2: (Kereta perang berat yang tertata dan mech bergerak bersenjata lengkap berdiri berdampingan, membangun tembok keputusasaan yang menyesakkan. Daya tembak perlengkapan ini sudah jauh melampaui spesifikasi P.M.C., bahkan sebagian nyaris identik dengan yang dipakai tentara reguler.)

column1: (In the gaps of the armored clusters, large numbers of heavy infantry were equipped with excellent individual combat weapons in squads. And in the far rear, the continuous self-propelled artillery positions had already locked onto Mokosh's dome.)
column2: (Di sela-sela gugusan lapis baja, infanteri berat dalam jumlah besar dilengkapi senjata tempur perorangan kelas atas per regu. Dan jauh di belakang, deretan posisi artileri swagerak sudah mengunci kubah Mokosh.)

column1: (Long-range artillery fire, infantry-tank coordination, aerial suppression by drone swarms, layered defenses relying on each other—this encirclement net attempted to eliminate any possibility of living creatures forcing their way in or breaking out.)
column2: (Tembakan artileri jarak jauh, koordinasi infanteri-tank, penekanan udara oleh kawanan drone, pertahanan berlapis yang saling menopang—jaring kepungan ini berusaha meniadakan segala kemungkinan makhluk hidup menerobos masuk atau keluar.)

column1: (After settling his wife and daughter, the man resolutely walked towards the Oathguards' recruitment office. And there were many others like him; just at the entrance of this defense facility in front of us, there were already dozens of civilians willing to join the fight.)
column2: (Setelah menempatkan istri dan putrinya, pria itu melangkah mantap ke kantor perekrutan Oathguards. Dan banyak orang lain seperti dia; di pintu masuk fasilitas pertahanan di depan kami saja, sudah ada puluhan warga sipil yang bersedia ikut bertempur.)

column1: (I once again brought up the tactical deployment plan that had been discussed countless times before. Although the enemy's heavy firepower exceeded expectations, it was still within the range that the original plan could handle, which also meant that Mokosh's original home-field advantage still existed—)
column2: (Sekali lagi kubuka rencana penempatan taktis yang sudah dibahas berkali-kali. Meski daya tembak berat musuh melampaui perkiraan, semuanya masih dalam jangkauan yang bisa ditangani rencana awal, artinya keunggulan kandang Mokosh masih ada—)

column1: (And brutal urban street fighting is exactly the quagmire the enemy desperately wants to avoid.)
column2: (Dan pertempuran jalanan kota yang brutal justru rawa yang mati-matian ingin dihindari musuh.)

column1: (Mokosh's spatial structure can be called a natural three-dimensional fortress. The building complexes outside the dome, the core living areas, commercial and factory facilities inside the dome, combined with the long-standing, intricate underground water pipe network, interweave into a bottomless defense net. Any area can be broken down into parts at any time, becoming an independent fortress that cuts off enemy forces and is easy to defend but hard to attack.)
column2: (Struktur ruang Mokosh bisa disebut benteng tiga dimensi alami. Kompleks bangunan di luar kubah, kawasan hunian inti, fasilitas komersial dan pabrik di dalam kubah, dipadu jaringan pipa air bawah tanah yang tua dan berliku, menganyam jaring pertahanan tanpa dasar. Area mana pun bisa dipecah jadi bagian-bagian kapan saja, menjadi benteng mandiri yang memutus pasukan musuh, mudah dipertahankan tapi sulit direbut.)

column1: (To completely capture Mokosh, the enemy will inevitably have to suffer incalculable battle damage and spend a long time.)
column2: (Untuk merebut Mokosh sepenuhnya, musuh mau tak mau harus menanggung kerusakan tempur yang tak terhitung dan waktu yang lama.)

column1: (As the analysis of the battle situation deepened, the solemn atmosphere in the conference room finally loosened. The gloom that had gathered between the brows of Mokosh's leaders at all levels due to the loss of the outer defense line also gradually dissipated.)
column2: (Seiring analisis situasi tempur makin dalam, suasana muram di ruang rapat akhirnya mencair. Kesuraman yang menggantung di kening para pemimpin Mokosh di semua tingkat akibat jatuhnya garis pertahanan luar pun perlahan sirna.)

column1: (I also struck while the iron was hot and set the main goal of this operation: using each Doll squad as the main force to consume the conglomerate's effective strength on the outskirts of Mokosh as much as possible. When the conglomerate finds that the losses far exceed expectations, this battle will have a chance of victory.)
column2: (Aku pun memanfaatkan momentum itu dan menetapkan sasaran utama operasi ini: menjadikan tiap regu Doll sebagai kekuatan utama untuk menggerus sebanyak mungkin kekuatan efektif konglomerat di pinggiran Mokosh. Begitu konglomerat menyadari kerugiannya jauh melampaui perkiraan, pertempuran ini punya peluang menang.)

column1: (My gaze slowly swept over the electronic terminal at hand—it was the material reserve list submitted by Vasily.)
column2: (Pandanganku perlahan menyapu terminal elektronik di tanganku—itu daftar cadangan material yang diserahkan Vasily.)

column1: (Under his precautions, Mokosh had already hoarded enough supplies and ammunition to support three months of high-intensity combat, and had built mutually supporting close-in defense fire networks both inside and out. In this cruel war of attrition, this set of detailed data is undoubtedly the strongest trump card in our hands.)
column2: (Berkat kesiagaannya, Mokosh sudah menimbun perbekalan dan amunisi yang cukup untuk menopang tiga bulan pertempuran intensitas tinggi, serta membangun jaring tembak pertahanan jarak dekat yang saling menopang di dalam maupun luar. Dalam perang gesekan yang kejam ini, data terperinci itu tak diragukan lagi kartu truf terkuat di tangan kami.)

column1: (Once the enemy's proud heavily armed cluster fell into the urban ruins, not only could they not utilize their absolute fire suppression, but their massive size would instead become a burden for the infantry advance, even turning them into sitting ducks.)
column2: (Begitu gugusan bersenjata berat yang dibanggakan musuh terjerumus ke reruntuhan kota, mereka bukan hanya tak bisa memanfaatkan tekanan tembakan mutlaknya, tapi ukuran raksasanya justru jadi beban bagi laju infanteri, bahkan menjadikan mereka sasaran empuk.)
